title: ACIS diagnostic published-slot budget fast slice
mode: Local bounded implementation and focused regression validation
scope: Charge each diagnostic slot when it moves from category staging into the public wireframe result
Add a generated positive/negative delta assertion and preserve the existing exact/one-under budget controls

finding.description: appendDiagnostic charged the category-local diagnostic staging slot, but appendDiagnostics then retained a second slot in DRW_AcisBrep::diagnostics without charging it. The public diagnostic string moved between vectors, but both vector slots were allocated during extraction.
finding.change: Charge one output item immediately before appending each moved diagnostic to the public result vector.
finding.regression: Compare locally generated valid-point and missing-point SAB inputs. The unresolved case must account for exactly two additional output slots: one category staging slot and one published result slot. Existing exact-cap and one-under-cap controls remain active.

workingTree.reasonUncommitted: The shared worktree contains extensive unrelated and earlier plan implementation edits, including in the same files. This narrow slice was left unstaged rather than committing unrelated user changes.
